item.description: ### Fixed - **Stats builds its history about six times faster.** The first time Stats opens, and again whenever an update changes how it counts, Perch reads every transcript on your Mac. It used to read them one at a time; it now reads several at once. Measured on one Mac with 1,600 files: 47 seconds down to 8. The numbers are unchanged. The progress count moves quickly and then pauses near the end while the largest transcripts finish — that is expected.
